title: DR1 tells the user to include the country code when a private transporter's phone number is international; the frontend's telephone field says nothing.

finding.frontend: The field is labelled "Telephone number" and has no hint at all (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/copy/copy.en.js:110 and private-transporter-details/private-transporter-details.njk:73-81). Nothing tells the user what to do with a number outside the UK, and this page routinely takes one — the country field beside it offers thirty-one countries other than the United Kingdom.
finding.prototype: The field is labelled "Phone number" and hinted "For international numbers include the country code" (app/views/partials/transporter-add-private-fields.html:96-105).
finding.difference: Add the hint "For international numbers include the country code" under the field, and rename the label from "Telephone number" to "Phone number" to match. Copy only — the field, its validation and its position do not change.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a hint under the telephone field on fe-transporter-private — the captured DOM has the label and the input with no aria-describedby and no govuk-hint between them.
finding.verification: Read both rendered DOMs and both full-page screenshots, and read copy.en.js and the DR1 partial at the cited lines. Ran the falsifier: the frontend's captured DOM contains no govuk-hint anywhere on the form, and the telephone input at line 219 is <input class="govuk-input govuk-input--width-20" id="telephoneNumber" name="telephoneNumber" type="tel" value="" autocomplete="tel"> with no aria-describedby, so it does not fire. DR1's phone input carries hint text "For international numbers include the country code" under the label "Phone number", visible in the screenshot. Checked the supporting claim rather than taking it: the frontend's country select on that page holds 33 options — the "Select a country" placeholder, United Kingdom, and 31 others — so "thirty-one countries other than the United Kingdom" is exact. copy.en.js:110 is the "Telephone number" label to the line. CORRECT.
